sampling: whole questions in sha256("mathse-v2-va|" + question_id) order until >= 13000 rows, restricted to questions carrying BOTH signals

dense_accepted.recipe: Llama-3.1-8B LoRA r16/a32, lr5e-5, batch16, max_len1024, 2 epochs, gradient-checkpointing, select-on-eval (dense-standard, no deviation)
dense_accepted.y_definition: 1 = the asker's accepted answer, 0 = a non-accepted answer on the same question

dense_vote.recipe: Llama-3.1-8B LoRA r16/a32, lr5e-5, batch16, max_len1024, 2 epochs, gradient-checkpointing, select-on-eval (dense-standard, no deviation)
dense_vote.y_definition: 1 = raw vote score strictly above the median answer score on its own question, 0 = strictly below; ties at the median dropped
